Bars: median of three fresh processes, 5 warmup and 7 measured batches of 65,536 evaluations. Whiskers: minimum–maximum of three forks, not confidence intervals.

Ordinary Map inputs; every fixture except scalar binds all 69 variables, and repeated protobuf materializes every output element. Chips compare with the lower cel-java planner aggregate in that panel.
Prepared immutable inputs are a separate control, not pooled here.
Compiler and background-thread allocation are excluded. This is not retained heap or process size.
